method: ERC-20 Transfer logs to and from the wallet, all tokens, the whole window (eth_getLogs).
Signer (tx.from) of every outgoing transfer's transaction (eth_getTransactionByHash).
Every wallet-signed transaction in the window, located by nonce bisection (eth_getTransactionCount) and read from its block (eth_getBlockByNumber).
Wallet code at the window start and one block before the harmful block (eth_getCode).
Receipt status of each ETH-carrying wallet transaction (eth_getTransactionReceipt; the receipt's block must match), added 2026-10-28.
